title: The God of Chess
reviewNotes: Three branches, 16 exact positions from the seven-piece phase after ...d2 at 55 seconds. Nb5/Nc3/Ne4 builds a g3 mating threat, Qe2 pins the pawn, and Qc1 permits actual g3 mate. The representative Qf1/Kh2/Qe2 connection is independently supplied. Independent ...Qxe4 fxe4 leads to an exact draw, not a forced White win. Earlier eight-piece bishop capture remains source context.
